text: Separate joining a room from permission to act.

A room identifier finds a planned network session. It cannot prove a participant's role or ownership. An instructor, an active bidder and an observer have different permissions. Information being prepared by one team must not be editable by another. A trusted server is expected to verify who may change each piece of shared state.

items: Illustration: Another team's room link must not authorize changes to its plan or bids.

text: Enforce authority at the point where changes are accepted, not merely in the interface.
An anonymous workshop still needs scoped authorization and session recovery procedures.
